# Troolify

> Online tools hub by F9XR Team - free, fast, 100% client-side web utilities.

Every Troolify tool runs entirely in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

## Tools
- [Word Counter](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/text/word-counter.html): Live word, character, sentence and reading-time stats.
- [Numeronym Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/text/numeronym-generator.html): Generate i18n-style numeronyms from any phrase.
- [JSON Formatter](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/coding/json-formatter.html): Format, validate, minify and copy JSON instantly.
- [Code Beautifier](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/coding/code-beautifier.html): Turn source code into clean, colorful, self-contained HTML with syntax highlighting.
- [Schema Markup Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/seo/schema-markup-generator.html): Create clean JSON-LD schema markup for LocalBusiness, Product, Article, FAQPage, Event and Review.
- [YouTube Timestamp Link Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/youtube/timestamp-link-generator.html): Clickable timestamp links and instant video-description chapters.
- [Song Length Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/audio/song-length-calculator.html): Calculate exact track runtime from BPM and bar repetitions.
- [Password Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/misc/password-generator.html): Create strong random passwords or memorable passphrases with custom rules and entropy strength.
- [Password Entropy Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/misc/password-entropy-calculator.html): Measure password entropy in bits and estimate crack time across five real-world attack scenarios.
